user.description: Enter the connection details for your VoiceMeeter host. The Command Stream name must match the 'VBAN Text Incoming Stream' name configured in VoiceMeeter (default is 'Command1'). The Media Stream name must match a 'VBAN Audio Incoming Stream' name (default is 'Stream1').

data_description.macro_buttons: Comma-separated indexes, for example 32, 33. Each index adds a push button and a disabled switch.

error.invalid_macro_buttons: Use whole numbers from 0 to 79, separated by commas.

send_raw_command.name: Send raw command
send_raw_command.description: Sends a raw text command to the targeted VoiceMeeter device.

press_macro_button.name: Press macro button
press_macro_button.description: Sends Command.Button[n].State to VoiceMeeter. State on sends 1, off sends 0.

button.name: Button
button.description: Macro button index, the same number as in Command.Button[n].

state.name: Pressed
state.description: On sends State=1. Off sends State=0.

set_gain.name: Set gain
set_gain.description: Set gain for a specific strip or bus number entity.

set_mute.name: Set mute
set_mute.description: Set mute state for a specific strip or bus switch entity.
